tei:div.tei:p: 487)༈ shes rab dbang mos bde ba'i rdo rje la smras pa// gzhan skyon mkhyen pa'i shes rab mig ldan ma// rang skyon dug gis me tog bzhad la ltos// bla ma'i mdzad spyod thams cad chos sku'i ngang*// gang snang rang grol ro snyoms chen por rtogs// de la khyed kyis kun brtags skyon du mthong*// mtshams med las ngan bsags pa a thang chad// gsal stong ngo bo lha ru ma shes shing*// lha gzhan rang rgyud 'dzin pa a thang chad// sgra grags sngags kyi dgongs spyod ma ldan na// rnam rtog grangs su 'debs pa a thang chad// dran rtog mnyam nyid chos skur ma rtogs na// mchog 'dzin shes pa tsam la a thang chad// rang skyon ri bo tsam zhig bag nyal byas// gzhan gyi spyod pa bcos pa a thang chad// ma rig mun pa'i khrod na khyod re sdug /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bla btsong thang re chad// de don soms la sems la dam bca' zungs// thams cad btang snyoms ngang du skyur la thongs// de skad dug lnga me 'bar mdor zhig pa// su kha'i ming la shes rab dbang mos gdams// rang 488)ngor ltos la kha rog nyol la sdod/ ces smras pa'o// he he/ bar chad yin zhes rwa can mi 'byung zhing*// glo bur kun rtog dmag brgyas do zla min// thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i shan pa yin// ma rig mun pa'i phag nas rang dang 'grogs// shes rab dbang mo khyed kyis bzlog tu gsol/ su kha'i ming gis so// ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi// phrin las mdzad pa rmad byung bsam mi khyab// gcig bsdus dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// rnam kun mchog ldan dpa' bo he ru ka /padma'i pha phogs thob pas snying thig dbang*// ma rig 'gro khams chos kyi sgron me sbar// gang 'dul phrin las mdzad pa mtha' ru phyin// gsang mdzod zab mo'i chos kyi gter grol nas// bla med sngags kyi dgongs bcud zab mo yis// las can rjes bzung smin grol lam la bkod// gling pa rnam lnga gter chen brgya rtsa dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras 'dus pa'i ngo bo mchog

/bka' drin mtshungs med zhabs la gus pas 'dud// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum mchod pa 'bul// 'di phyi kun tu 'bral med byin gyis rlobs/ 489)/mtshan dpe rab rdzogs sku yi dkyil 'khor mdzes// lta bas mi ngoms mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zhi ma khro 'dzum ldan// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang ye shes ngang du grol// spyan dkyil 'bru tshugs bdud tshogs zil gyis gnan// ma rig 'khrul 'dzin rig stong chos skur bcom// lcang lo ma bcos zur phud thod du bcings// sku gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro'i srog bcud 'dzin// sku yi 'od kyis sangs rgyas zhing kun khyab// 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa'i smag rum sel// yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku mnga' brnyes// gsung gi nga ros gsang sngags chos sgra sgrog /ji snyed don kun ji bzin blo gros thob// 'gro ba'i khams dbang dang mthun sa lam gyi// bgrod tshul lugs gnyis theg pa'i chos mtha' dag /rnam grangs dbye ba dang bcas thogs med mkhyen// ngag gi dbang phyug mkhyen brtse rol pa'i bdag /dus gsum kun mkhyen khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// sku gsum mngon gyur spros bral g.yo ba med// mkhyen gnyis ye shes chen po'i shes rab kyis// nyon mongs ma spangs rang grol chos nyid ngang*/ 490)/chos dbyings ngang las 'gyur med gnyug ma'i klong*// 'khrul grol gnyis med ye grol chos sku'i thugs// mtshan thos tsam gyis gnyis 'dzin zhen pa chod// 'khor bar blo ldog yang dag chos la spyod// mthong bas ma rig sgrib gnyis dbyings su dag /bde chen ye shes rang zhal mngon du gyur// sbyor ba'i rlung sems dbang bsgyur chos nyid mthong*// 'pho chen sku thob gzhon nu bum skur 'khyol// zab don snying po'i sgo 'byed lde mig mchog /tshe bsod dpal 'byor gdul bya rgyas mdzad pa'i// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpa' bo khyod lta bu/

kho mos sngar yang ma rnyed da ci mthong*// bral dgos snying mig srog las phangs na yang*// rang nyid bsod nams dman pas gzhan dbang song*// bral dgos byung tshe rjes brtses mi 'dor bar// thugs rjes rgyun chad med par gzigs su gsol/ 'di phyi'i re ltos skyabs mgon khyed las med// las ngan bdag ni yul gzhan bgrod pa'i tshe// snying med mi bzhin gtad med had por rgyu// song nas dkar nag 'khyud 'khor chod pa dkon/ bka' drin can gyi yon tan thugs rje dran// smre bsngags 'o dod gsol ba drag 491)tu btab// skyabs med bdag ni skyabs gnas gar bzhugs kyang*// bdag gi lus bral sems nyid 'di ru 'phos// tshe bsod dpal 'byor 'dus pa'i srog rten nṛ// skye med rang byung a yig rnam pa ru// sems khams dbyings phyug ma dang dbyer med rol// rang byung sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror lhun gyis grub// chos dbyings ye shes klong du gnyis med 'pho// sha khams sangs rgyas spyan dang dbyer med grol// rang byung rdo rje mkha' 'gror= me long ye shes= khrag khams ma ma ki dang= rang byung rin chen mkha' 'gror= mnyam nyid ye shes= drod khams gos dkar mo dang= rang byung padma mkha' 'gror= sor rtogs ye shes= dbugs khams dam tshig sgrol dang= rang byung karma mkha' 'gror= bya grub ye shes= dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga dbyer med grol// lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa'i dgongs klong du// gnyis med ro gcig thabs dang dbyer med 'pho// zung 'jug snang stong chos sku'i ngang du grol// 'pho med rdo rje'i sku dang gnyis med bsre// shes rab snang cha thabs kyi klong du 'pho// sgyu lus mi snang 'od gsal ngang du yal// bzang ngan 'brel bcas 'khor bar mi gnas par// lhun grub 492)dag pa'i zhing du grol bar shog /kye hud kye hud gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ khyed rnams thugs rje byin rlabs mthu yod na// bdag gi grogs dang 'bral med mthu dpung bskyed// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad mi mthun kun// phrin las drag pos tshar gcod bzlog tu gsol// thabs shes 'bral med myur du 'dum pa dang*// mdzad phrin nam mkha' bzhin du rgyas pa dang*// snyan grags srid zhi sa gsum khyab par mdzod// 'grub par shog cig gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i mthus// bsam don lhun grub dngos grub bstsal du gsol/

ces pa'ang dus 'dzin khyi lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin rkyen snang gis gnad bskul tshe yid shin tu skyo ba'i ngang nas gang dran chal chol du lus dman 'du shes gsum mas smras pa'o// dge'o// ༈ rgyal kun 'dus zhal padma thod phreng rtsal// dbyings yum ḍā ki ye shes mtsho rgyal ma/ khye'u chung lo tsā nam mkha'i snying po sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dus ngan snyigs ma'i rang mtshang rang gis ston// bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba gting nas skyes// gter min gter 'dras sa steng yongs la gang*// theg dgu'i gnas bsdus gdams pa 493)sna gcig med/ zab chos ya ma zung 'brel mang du spel// zab zab lung bstan zer zhing rang mgo bskor// 'gro don yin zer nag chang dang du blangs// gtsang btsog med pa khyi phag lta bur spyod// dad pa chung zhing rang rgyud rwa ltar gyong*// tshul khrims mi ldan dug lnga 'chol nyog spyod// dam pa gong ma rnams la skur pa 'debs// grub pa thob zer mi dge sna tshogs gsog /cha lugs mi mthun gang dran bab col byed// rang don sna gcig med kyang gzhan don rloms// zla gcig tsam yang sgom sgrub mi brtson zhing*// yul grong dgon gseb kun tu dkor la rgyug /dal khoms med par nyin mtshan 'khor yug 'grims// gu ru padma'i bla btsong yi re mug /de 'dra'i gter ston lus su bdag ma gyur// bdag ni skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du// rig 'dzin yab sras rnams kyis rjes bzung nas// smin grol gdams pa'i dpal la longs spyod cing*/ theg dgu'i gnad la rim bgrod mi ltos par// theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po mngon gyur nas// theg chen 'bras bu'i 484)'od gsal rab smin shog ces pa'ang dus mtha'i gter ming 'dzin pa rang cag rnams kyi spyod pa la zhe khrel nas su kha'i ming gis smon tshig tu bris pa'o// dge'o//
